question: In a certain code language, BUG is coded as 24 and TWO is coded as 52. What is the code for ONE in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

BUG is coded as 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d57e10692d1cfe3b4b59417c3f778e2c1dc5b46999ec270ef0dc36cf0ed138e.png] 

And,

TWO is coded as 52

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbe9f4918499ae3ab5c0e4e8ee04fa4ec8284b31bdc0e0285a773d07b6a1e7ab.png] 

Similarly,

ONE will be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259b69c4178f521d84b6793d5f20f275df1dc774405a0b5044dbf07a9fdf8db2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea019cb9cbd4677e41767bed74161292a9a11fc70ade0568ce66cd0c3c88e2ef.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
